quarterly_data.quarter: Diodes press release: Diodes Completes Acquisition of ElevATE Semiconductor, (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Diodes completed its acquisition of ElevATE Semiconductor, a San Diego, California-based fabless provider of low-power analog and mixed-signal ICs for the Automated Test Equipment (ATE) market; ElevATE will operate as a product line within Diodes. The release repeats that ElevATE is expected to contribute approximately $50 million in revenue in the first twelve months after close and to be immediately accretive to revenue, gross margin and EPS.
quarterly_data.figure: acquisition completed; approximately $50 million revenue expected in first twelve months after close
